primary.title: Spontaneous oscillations and negative-conductance transitions in microfluidic networks
primary.source_equations: SI S1-S2, S5-S12; parameters S13 plus S4 caption and main network dimensions.
primary.known_behavior: Full network source Fig.S5 has periodic and multistable branches; source describes supercritical Hopf and homoclinic bifurcations. Isolated chicane Eqs.2-3 is a different planar subsystem.

model.energy_supply: Maintained constant inlet pressures; no periodic input or finite fuel reservoir.
model.units: All source equations below use dimensionless time and variables.
critical_transcription_notes: Both eta and xi depend on Q1 through source S1-S2; freezing xi changes the model and violates its zero-flow identity.
Minor-loss coefficients appear with literal PLUS signs in S7/S9; visually verified.
P3 and P4 are algebraic pressures, not extra dynamical states.
Do not mix the isolated main-text Fig.6 parameter set with the full-network S13 fit.

our_exact_pressure_elimination.solve: A*[P3,P4]^T=b; then use source equations Q1dot,Q2dot,Q3dot,rdot.
our_exact_pressure_elimination.determinant_identity: With A0=1/L1+1/L5 and B0=1/L2+1/L4, det(A)=A0*B0+(A0+zeta*B0)/L3>0 for positive lengths and zeta.

suggested_first_reproduction.basis: Inside periodic window pictured in source Fig.S5; not integrated here.

physical_domain_and_limits.singularity: Rational minor-loss term singular at x=0; do not regularize silently.
physical_domain_and_limits.flow_reversal: The source Forchheimer Q4^2 term and junction fit assume the illustrated flow directions. Replacing Q4^2 by Q4*abs(Q4) changes the closure.
physical_domain_and_limits.parameter_variation: Changing fitted coefficients independently is a mathematical sensitivity study, not automatically a realizable geometry change.
physical_domain_and_limits.hydrodynamic_validity: A four-state ODE attractor would require further comparison with fluid dynamics. Two-dimensional flow approximation is not calibrated for arbitrary finite-depth devices.

algebraic_check.purpose: Validate our algebraic pressure elimination against all five original flow equations; not a trajectory, stability, or boundedness test.

closest_prior_chaos.title: Emergent oscillations and chaos in noncompliant microfluidic networks
closest_prior_chaos.read_scope: Full primary manuscript; especially sections II-IV, equations 1-2 and Figs.6-7.
closest_prior_chaos.evidence_type: Period doubling and Lyapunov estimate from two-dimensional Navier-Stokes DNS time series, with embedding checks.
closest_prior_chaos.mechanism: Autonomous Eulerian flow-rate chaos in serialized rigid networks, not merely chaotic passive particle advection.
closest_prior_chaos.exact_model_difference: Simplified blade geometry without the strongly nonlinear obstacle-laden branch; elementary network described by two POD modes; chaos shown after serialization in DNS. Not the 2020 four-state phenomenological S5-S12 closure.
closest_prior_chaos.priority_effect: First chaos in this broad mechanism is already published. Exact-2020-closure novelty remains unresolved.
